scope: Observation capture, processing, recovery and useful-note quality

upstream.target: main; not identical to stable v13.24.1

verdict: Targeted observation-capture mechanisms now have corresponding implementation and regression coverage. Universal parity or model-quality superiority is not established; a Claude-provider A/B was unavailable.

model_comparison.limitation: Claude CLI was unauthenticated and no subscription was available. Native Luna/medium synthetic scenarios verify bounded behavior only.

criteria.codex_mem: Separate redacted tool input and response, up to 64 KiB each; valid JSON head/tail wrappers and explicit truncation metadata; full retained text supplied to the observer. Binary/media payloads are excluded.
Wake the durable queue after committed tool and final-answer captures; Stop processing remains a fallback.
A failed project must remain blocked without automatic retries while other eligible projects continue.
Bounded same-session history; Stop includes prior derived notes by raw source chronology, excludes post-Stop evidence, and retains links to context notes.
SQLite job leases, atomic commit and explicit failed-job retry; original captured excerpts retained.
Durable SQLite tool-use side index, idempotent IDs, bounded hydration and explicit MCP/CLI inspection. Recovery uses persistent jobs; an audit replay plan is inert and does not execute tools.
Nine observation types, subtitle/facts/narrative/concepts/files fields, structured file/concept/type filters, and a dedicated Stop summary schema. Atomic source attribution is retained.
Configurable tool skip list, same-session private-prompt gate until the next public prompt, memory self-tool exclusions, field-aware redaction before persistence.

early_corpus_review.finding: The generic privacy statement plus injection was skipped. Safety held, but the original fixture incorrectly demanded retention of a generic statement. The final corpus separates generic-injection skip from a concrete verified fix with injection.

native_corpus.assembly: 8 unchanged passed cases plus reruns of the 2 corrected fixtures

known_findings: Earlier runs exposed exact-identifier loss, a skipped contradictory verification result, and routine text in summaries. Observer instructions were corrected; these failures are not relabeled as original passes.
The initial fixture printed an unverified success claim; the final native capture probe executes a UNIQUE-constraint regression before reporting success.
The probe initially closed its app-server before Stop completed; it now waits for the Stop record before shutdown.
Asynchronously written notes were missing from Stop context. Selection now follows raw source causality and batches end at Stop; summaries retain context-note links.
Mandatory Stop-summary provenance is distinct from promotion of incidental Stop text. Noise-content assertions check both observations and summaries.
Required summary batches now explicitly summarize prior structured findings even when Stop only acknowledges completion. Invalid responses remain blocked for explicit retry.

native_corpus.fixture_boundary: Ordinary tool evidence no longer uses artificial Stop events; request remains UserPromptSubmit. Content expectations retained. Dedicated Stop is tested separately.

native_tool_and_stop.scope: Temporary project; actual shell and hook capture, then explicit process_pending drain. Not a new detached-service scheduling test.

comparison_codex_case.environment_failure: An initial sandbox run failed before model execution because app-server SQLite access was denied. The authorized host rerun passed.

privacy_and_transport_regressions: Shell punctuation does not bypass sensitive path matching.
Top-level and nested media/data payloads are excluded.
Raw inspection responses have a 256 KiB JSON budget with explicit field truncation.
Stop batches exclude future events; legacy summary attribution is checked again before commit.
